recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin）下，增厚不規則的骨小樑之間，髓腔被瀰漫、交織、呈流水狀的纖維網取代，造血細胞幾乎消失，符合骨髓纖維化的高度網狀纖維增生；本圖對比偏淡，精確分級受限。
features: Thickened, irregular and interconnecting bony trabeculae (osteosclerosis)
Diffuse dense meshwork of intersecting fibers throughout the intertrabecular spaces, with streaming bundles
Markedly reduced hematopoietic cellularity with dilated spaces and scattered fat vacuoles
Staining contrast is weak (reddish-brown rather than crisp black fibers), limiting precise MF grading
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy stained for reticulin shows thickened, irregular trabeculae with the intertrabecular marrow replaced by a diffuse, dense, intersecting fiber network with streaming bundles. Hematopoietic cells are sparse. Although the staining contrast in this photomicrograph is suboptimal for precise grading, the diffuse dense fiber network with osteosclerosis suggests high-grade reticulin fibrosis (MF-2 to MF-3). Findings are consistent with fibrotic-stage primary myelofibrosis in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Shows hypercellular marrow with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and at most MF-1 reticulin, not diffuse dense fibrosis with osteosclerosis.
Reticulin pattern is identical; distinction depends on prior documented PV or ET.
Features acute onset with increased CD34-positive blasts and dysplastic small megakaryocytes in the fibrotic marrow, without prior MPN and usually without splenomegaly.

ddx.dx: Reactive fibrosis (e.g., hyperparathyroidism, infection, autoimmune myelofibrosis)
ddx.vs: Typically focal/peritrabecular or low-grade reticulin with preserved hematopoiesis and no atypical megakaryocytes or MPN driver mutation.
